title: The hamlet with one mind
about: The `hamlet` world with only the subject (the youngest adult) thought for: LIVING_ONLY names it, and the other eleven live on their seeded ways and instincts (graphs), as in a scripted trial. The run goes on to its duration after the subject's death, with no mind, so births and deaths are counted the same way as in `hamlet`.
gradient: Experiment 2: the same person among people who think and among people who run their graphs.
